facts.statement: Remains of at least ten individuals were recovered starting in 1895 from the Hunedoara region in what was then Hungary but is now western Romania.
facts.quote: Remains belonging to at least ten individuals have been recovered since 1895 from the Hunedoara region (Sânpetru Formation) in the area which was, at the time of their discovery, Hungary, but is now western Romania.

facts.statement: Friedrich von Huene reassigned the taxon to the new genus Magyarosaurus in 1932 and named two additional species, M. hungaricus and M. transsylvanicus.
facts.quote: In 1932, Friedrich von Huene reassigned this taxon to a new genus, Magyarosaurus, and he also named two other species within the genus: M. hungaricus and M. transsylvanicus.

facts.statement: No skull remains are known for Magyarosaurus.
facts.quote: No remains of skulls are known.

facts.statement: Fourteen fossil eggs have been discovered and attributed to Magyarosaurus.
facts.quote: There has been a discovery of 14 fossil eggs which have been attributed to Magyarosaurus.

facts.statement: Specimens of M. dacus measure between 2.16 and 2.82 meters long and weigh up to 660 to 972 kg.
facts.quote: Magyarosaurus was a relatively small sauropod, with specimens currently referrable to M. dacus measuring 2.16 - 2.82 m long and weighing up to 660 - 972 kg.

facts.statement: Magyarosaurus is notable for the presence of dermal armour.
facts.quote: Magyarosaurus is also notable for the presence of dermal armour.

facts.statement: While some researchers initially suggested Magyarosaurus fossils represented juveniles, a 2010 study of bone growth patterns supported the hypothesis that they were adults.
facts.quote: Later researchers doubted his conclusions, suggesting instead that the known Magyarosaurus fossil represented juveniles. However, a detailed study of bone growth patterns published in 2010 supported Nopcsa's original hypothesis, showing that the small Magyarosaurus individuals were adults.

facts.statement: Histological studies show that Magyarosaurus had a very reduced growth rate but maintained a high metabolic rate.
facts.quote: The histology of Magyarosaurus showed that it had a very reduced growth rate, but even so, had a high metabolic rate.

facts.statement: The Hațeg Basin environment changed from subhumid with seasonal precipitation in the early Maastrichtian to an extensive wetland in the later age of the formation.
facts.quote: During the early Maastrichtian, the Hațeg Basin was subhumid, and had seasonal precipitation. However, during the later age of the formation, a large-scale paleoenvironmental change occurred, the region transformed into an extensive wetland.

facts.statement: A 2005 study found Magyarosaurus to be a close relative of Rapetosaurus within the family Saltasauridae and the sauropod clade Titanosauria.
facts.quote: It has been found to be a close relative of Rapetosaurus in the family Saltasauridae in the sauropod clade Titanosauria in a 2005 study.

facts.statement: It is estimated that Magyarosaurus weighed 1.1 tons.
facts.quote: Se estima que Magyarosaurus tenía un peso de 1,1 toneladas.

facts.statement: According to Curry Rogers et al., the estimated length of Magyarosaurus is 6 meters.
facts.quote: La longitud estimada de Magyarosaurus es de 6 metros,según Curry Rogers et al..

facts.statement: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul provided lower weight estimates of one ton with the same length.
facts.quote: En 2010 Gregory S. Paul dio estimaciones más bajas de una tonelada con la misma longitud.

facts.statement: The species was initially named Titanosaurus dacus by Baron Nopcsa in 1915.
facts.quote: Inicialmente fueron nombrados Titanosaurus dacus, el nombre específico que se refiere a los Dacios, que habían vivido en ese lugar hace unos 2000 años, por el Barón Nopcsa en 1915.

facts.statement: The species was renamed Magyarosaurus dacus by Friedrich von Huene in 1932.
facts.quote: La especie fue más tarde renombrado Magyarosaurus dacus por Friedrich von Huene en 1932.

facts.statement: Remains belonging to at least 10 individuals have been recovered from the Hunedoara region in the Sânpetru Formation, an area that was discovered in Hungary but is now western Romania.
facts.quote: Se han recuperado restos pertenecientes a al menos 10 individuos de la región de Hunedoara, Formación Sânpetru, en el área que fue durante su descubrimiento en Hungría, pero ahora es el oeste de Rumania.

facts.statement: The holotype, BMNH R.3861a, consists of a set of vertebrae.
facts.quote: El holotipo , BMNH R.3861a, consiste en un conjunto de vértebras.

facts.statement: A 2005 study found it to be a close relative of Rapetosaurus within the Saltasauridae family and the Titanosauria clade.
facts.quote: Se ha encontrado que es un pariente cercano de Rapetosaurus en la familia Saltasauridae en el clado de saurópodos Titanosauria en un estudio de 2005.

facts.statement: Magyarosaurus dacus is known from the early Maastrichtian of the Sânpetru Formation in the Hațeg Basin, Romania.
facts.quote: Magyarosaurus dacus es conocido desde principios de Maastrichtiense de la Formación Sânpetru, parte de la cuenca de Hațeg en Rumania.

facts.statement: In the early Maastrichtian, the Hațeg Basin was subhumid with seasonal rainfall.
facts.quote: A principios de Maastrichtiense , la cuenca de Hațeg era subhúmeda y presentaba precipitaciones estacionales.

facts.statement: During the late age of the formation, the region transformed into an extensive wetland.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, durante la última edad de la formación, se produjo un cambio paleoambiental a gran escala, la región se transformó en un extenso humedal.

facts.statement: The islands it inhabited led to Magyarosaurus becoming an island dwarf due to selective pressures from limited food supply and a lack of predators, favoring a smaller body size.
facts.quote: Las islas que habitaba llevaron a Magyarosaurus a convertirse en un producto del enanismo insular como resultado de las presiones selectivas presentadas por el suministro limitado de alimentos y la falta de depredadores, todo lo que favorece un tamaño corporal más pequeño.

facts.statement: Later researchers doubted the island dwarfism hypothesis, suggesting instead that the known Magyarosaurus fossils represented juveniles.
facts.quote: Investigadores posteriores dudaron de sus conclusiones, sugiriendo en cambio que los fósiles conocido de Magyarosaurus representan juveniles.

facts.statement: However, a detailed study of bone growth patterns published in 2010 supported Nopcsa's original hypothesis, showing that the small Magyarosaurus individuals were adults.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, un estudio detallado de los patrones de crecimiento óseo publicado en 2010 apoyó la hipótesis original de Nopcsa, mostrando que los pequeños individuos de Magyarosaurus eran adultos.

facts.statement: Koen Stein et al. studied the histology of Magyarosaurus and discovered that even the smallest individuals appeared to be adults.
facts.quote: Koen Stein et al. estudió la histología de Magyarosaurus. Descubrieron que incluso los individuos más pequeños parecían ser adultos.

facts.statement: The histology of Magyarosaurus showed it had a very reduced growth rate but still possessed a high metabolic rate.
facts.quote: La histología de Magyarosaurus mostró que tenía una tasa de crecimiento muy reducida, pero aun así, tenía una tasa metabólica alta.

facts.statement: No skull remains are known.
facts.quote: No se conocen restos de calaveras.

facts.statement: Many other bones have been found, mainly caudal vertebrae, but also dorsal vertebrae and appendicular skeleton elements.
facts.quote: Se han encontrado muchos otros huesos, principalmente vértebras caudales, pero también dorsales y elementos del esqueleto apendicular.

facts.statement: Embryos were preserved inside the eggs, and one egg shows evidence of dermal armor.
facts.quote: Los embriones se conservaron dentro de los huevos, y un huevo muestra prueba de armadura dérmica.

facts.statement: They were originally identified as nests, but it has now been demonstrated that nesting structures were not preserved.
facts.quote: Originalmente se identificaron como en nidos, pero ahora se ha demostrado que no se han conservado estructuras de anidación.

facts.statement: Along with Magyarosaurus, Telmatosaurus and Zalmoxes are also dwarf genera, as demonstrated by their histology.
facts.quote: Junto con Magyarosaurus, Telmatosaurus y Zalmoxes también son géneros enanos, como lo demuestra su histología.

facts.statement: Its parent group is Eutitanosauria.
facts.quote: Parent group: Eutitanosauria

facts.statement: It belongs to the class Saurischia.
facts.quote: Class: Saurischia

facts.statement: It lived from 72.2 to 66 million years ago during the Maastrichtian.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Maastrichtian (72.2 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: Other species, M. hungaricus and M. transsylvanicus, were synonymized with M. dacus by Le Loeuff in 1993 and Upchurch et al. in 2004.
facts.quote: Fueron sinonimizados con M. dacus por Le Loeuff en 1993 y Upchurch et al. en 2004.

facts.statement: It is debated whether M. hungaricus, which is larger and less frequent, represents a distinct taxon.
facts.quote: Más grande y menos frecuente, M. hungaricus puede representar un taxón distinto.
